died.name: Edmund Ironside
died.cause: According to Henry of Huntington, the English king was stabbed while on a toilet by an assassin hiding underneath.

died.name: Charles XII
died.cause: when stepping down from his perch into an entrenchment just as he was shot in the head

died.name: Harriet Newell
died.last_words: The pains, the groans, the dying strife. How long, O Lord, how long?

died.name: Oscar Wilde
died.last_words: My wallpaper and I are fighting a duel to the death. One or the other of us has to go.

died.name: Martha Mansfield
died.cause: While the 24-year-old American film actress was on location in San Antonio, Texas filming the American Civil War drama The Warrens of Virginia, a lit match was carelessly tossed by a crew member, which ignited the hoop skirts and ruffles of her Civil War costume. Co-star Wilfred Lytell and a chauffeur were able to extinguish the flames and rush her to a hospital, where she died the following day from her injuries.

died.name: Tiny Tim
died.desc: American musician, ukulele player and musical archivist
died.cause: to his wife after she asked if he was alright, right before collapsing on stage during a performance of "Tip-Toe Through the Tulips"

born.name: Philip Sidney

born.last_words: Take it; thy need is greater than mine.

born.cause: to his executioner prior to beheading for alleged treason

born.name: Jonathan Swift
born.cause: referring to George Frideric Handel, who had come to visit him
born.last_words: Ah! A German and a genius! A prodigy-admit him!

born.name: Lucy Maud Montgomery
born.cause: conclusion of note found on her bedside table after her death. It may or may not have been a suicide note
born.last_words: I have lost my mind by spells and I do not dare think what I may do in those spells. May God forgive me and I hope everyone else will forgive me even if they cannot understand. My position is too awful to endure and nobody realizes it. What an end to a life in which I tried always to do my best.
